en.headline: Police arrest 89 in three-day anti-triad operation
en.dek: Officers said the operation, codenamed Flowing Shade, ran from Sunday to Tuesday and seized etomidate, methamphetamine and cocaine.
body: Police arrested 89 people in a three-day operation against triad and organised-crime activity, the force said on Wednesday. The Organized Crime and Triad Bureau worked with the Narcotics Bureau and regional units from Sunday to Tuesday under the codename Flowing Shade.

More than 2,100 officers took part, visiting 56 premises including bars and restaurants and searching 12 locations, police said. Those arrested were 56 men and 33 women aged 16 to 65, including four children. Suspected offences included trafficking and possession of dangerous drugs, wounding, possession of an offensive weapon, unlawful detention, assault, criminal damage, obtaining property by deception, money laundering, unlicensed sale of liquor, and immigration offences.

Seizures included about 25 kilograms of etomidate powder, 203 etomidate cartridges, about 1.59 kilograms of suspected methamphetamine, about 805.9 grams of suspected cocaine powder, about 444 grams of suspected crack cocaine, and about 12 grams of suspected herbal cannabis, police said. Officers also seized two knives, three electric bicycles and 192 bottles of beer.

zh.headline: 警方三日反黑行動拘捕89人 檢獲依托咪酯及可卡因
zh.dek: 有組織罪案及三合會調查科稱，代號「逸影」的行動於周日至今早展開，檢獲依托咪酯、冰毒及可卡因。
body: 警方周三公布，有組織罪案及三合會調查科聯同毒品調查科及各總區，於周日至今早一連三日展開代號「逸影」的反罪惡及反三合會行動，共拘捕89人。
警方表示，行動動員超過2100人次，巡查56處處所，包括酒吧及食肆，並突擊搜查12處處所。被捕人為56男33女，年齡介乎16至65歲，當中包括4名兒童。涉嫌罪行包括販運及管有危險藥物、傷人、管有攻擊性武器、非法禁錮、襲擊、刑事毀壞、以欺騙手段取得財產、洗黑錢、無牌售賣酒類，以及入境相關罪行。
警方稱檢獲約25公斤依托咪酯粉末、203粒依托咪酯煙彈、約1.59公斤懷疑冰毒、約805.9克懷疑可卡因粉末、約444克懷疑霹靂可卡因，以及約12克懷疑草本大麻，另有兩把刀、三架電動單車及192支啤酒。
